about: House recipes, batch 04 (slice B): written by Claude in a Max-plan session, original, ai-draft. Nutrition is a per-serve estimate kept as data only.

recipes.title: Sesame Seed Balls with Sweet Potato Filling
recipes.summary: Crisp fried glutinous rice balls coated in sesame with a sweet potato centre.
steps: Boil the sweet potato for 12 minutes until soft, drain, mash with the sugar and cool, then roll into 8 balls.
Mix the flour with the hot water into a soft dough, divide into 8 and flatten each piece.
Wrap each piece around a filling ball, seal well and roll in the sesame seed until evenly coated.
Fry in oil heated to 150°C for 6 minutes, turning until golden and puffed, then drain on paper.
notes: Dessert. Vegan and gluten-free. Keep the oil at a steady heat so the balls cook through.

recipes.title: Egg Tart Cups with Flaky Pastry
recipes.summary: Cantonese-style custard tarts with a golden, lightly set filling.
steps: Cut the pastry into rounds and press into a 12-hole tin, then chill.
Dissolve the sugar in the hot water, cool, then whisk in the eggs, milk and vanilla and strain.
Fill each case nearly to the top.
Bake at 200°C for 20 minutes until the pastry is golden and the custard is just set with a small wobble.
notes: Food safety: bake until the custard is set through, at 75°C or more. Plus 20 minutes chilling. Dessert. Vegetarian.

recipes.title: Cold Sesame Noodles with Cucumber
recipes.summary: Chewy noodles in a creamy peanut-sesame sauce with crisp cucumber.
steps: Boil the noodles for 5 minutes until tender, rinse under cold water and drain well.
Whisk the peanut butter, tahini, soy sauce, vinegar, chilli oil and sesame oil with 2 tbsp warm water until smooth.
Toss the noodles with the sauce, cucumber and spring onion until coated.
notes: Vegan.

recipes.title: Silky Tomato Scramble Rice Plates
recipes.summary: Silky scrambled eggs folded through sweet-savoury tomatoes, a classic home dinner.
steps: Cook the rice by your usual method until fluffy.
Beat the eggs with a pinch of salt and scramble in the hot oil for 1 minute until just set, then lift out.
Fry the tomato for 4 minutes until it breaks down, then stir in the sugar and soy.
Return the eggs and toss gently, then scatter with spring onion and serve with the rice.
notes: Food safety: cook the eggs until set, with no liquid remaining. Vegetarian.

recipes.title: Chicken and Corn Congee
recipes.summary: Comforting slow-cooked rice porridge with chicken, ginger and sweet corn.
steps: Simmer the rice, stock and ginger for 35 minutes, stirring until the grains break down into a thick porridge.
Add the chicken whole and simmer for 12 minutes until cooked through, then shred.
Return the chicken, add the corn and soy sauce and cook for 3 minutes until hot.
Ladle into bowls and top with spring onion and sesame oil.
notes: Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C and be white throughout.

recipes.title: Steamed Pork and Mushroom Shumai
recipes.summary: Open-top steamed pork dumplings with shiitake and ginger.
steps: Mix the pork, mushroom, ginger, soy sauce, sesame oil and cornflour until sticky.
Place a spoonful on each wrapper, gather the edges around it and press the top flat.
Top each with a little carrot.
Steam in batches over boiling water for 12 minutes until the filling is firm and cooked through.
notes: Food safety: pork must reach 75°C throughout.

recipes.title: Wok Rice with Prawns and Soft Egg Ribbons
recipes.summary: Wok-fried rice with fluffy egg, prawns and peas.

items: 3 cups jasmine rice, cooked and cooled

steps: Heat the oil in a wok over high heat and cook the prawns for 2 minutes until pink and opaque, then lift out.
Scramble the eggs in the same wok for 1 minute until just set.
Add the rice and peas and toss for 4 minutes until hot and lightly toasted.
Return the prawns, add the soy sauce and sesame oil and scatter with spring onion.
notes: Food safety: prawns must be opaque and pink; cool leftover rice and refrigerate within 1 hour.

recipes.title: Walnut Almond Cookies Chinese Style
recipes.summary: Crumbly, golden cookies with walnut and almond meal, easy and not too sweet.
steps: Cream the butter and sugar until pale, then beat in the yolk.
Mix in the flour, almond meal, baking powder and walnuts to a soft dough.
Roll into 12 balls, flatten slightly and place on a lined tray.
Bake at 170°C for 15 minutes until golden at the edges.
notes: Dessert. Vegetarian.

recipes.title: Miso Butter Corn Fritters
recipes.summary: Golden savoury fritters with sweet corn and miso, quick to fry.
steps: Mix the corn, flour, eggs, miso and spring onion into a thick batter.
Heat oil in a pan and drop in spoonfuls.
Fry for 3 minutes each side until golden and crisp.
Melt the butter and drizzle over the fritters to serve.
notes: Vegetarian.

recipes.title: Okonomiyaki Cabbage Pancakes
recipes.summary: Savoury Japanese pancakes loaded with cabbage, topped with sauce and mayonnaise.
steps: Whisk the flour, water and eggs into a batter and fold in the cabbage and spring onion.
Heat the oil in a pan and form two thick pancakes.
Cook over medium heat for 5 minutes each side until golden and cooked through.
Brush with sauce, drizzle with mayonnaise and scatter with bonito flakes.
notes: Food safety: cook until the centre is firm and hot, over 75°C.

recipes.title: Teriyaki Salmon Rice Bowls
recipes.summary: Glazed salmon over rice with edamame and pickled ginger.
steps: Cook the rice by your usual method until tender.
Pan-fry the salmon in the oil, skin side down, for 4 minutes, turn and cook for 3 minutes more.
Pour in the teriyaki sauce and cook for 1 minute until sticky.
Steam the edamame until bright green, then serve everything over the rice with ginger and nori.
notes: Food safety: salmon is cooked when it flakes easily, at 63°C.

recipes.title: Matcha-Free Black Sesame Mochi Waffles
recipes.summary: Chewy mochi-style waffles with a nutty sesame flavour.
steps: Toast the sesame seed in a dry pan for 3 minutes until golden, grind it, then mix with the flours, sugar and baking powder.
Whisk the eggs, milk and melted butter into the dry mix until smooth.
Cook in a hot waffle iron for 5 minutes until deep golden and crisp.
Serve the warm waffles with maple syrup poured over.
notes: Vegetarian.

recipes.title: Curry Udon with Mushrooms
recipes.summary: Thick noodles in a mild Japanese-style curry broth with mushrooms and spinach.
steps: Fry the onion in the oil for 4 minutes until soft, add the curry powder for 1 minute.
Add the stock, soy sauce, mirin and mushrooms and simmer for 8 minutes.
Add the udon and cook for 3 minutes until hot and tender.
Stir through the spinach until wilted.
notes: Vegan.

recipes.title: Dorayaki-Style Honey Pancake Sandwiches
recipes.summary: Soft honey pancakes sandwiched with sweet nut spread.
steps: Whisk the eggs, sugar and honey until pale and thick, then fold in the flour, baking powder and milk.
Cook small rounds in a lightly oiled pan for 2 minutes each side until golden.
Cool slightly and sandwich pairs with the peanut butter.
notes: Dessert. Vegetarian.

recipes.title: Chawanmushi Egg Custard with Mushroom
recipes.summary: Silky steamed savoury egg custard with dashi and mushroom.
steps: Whisk the eggs with the dashi, soy sauce and mirin and strain into 4 cups.
Add the mushrooms and cover each cup tightly with foil.
Steam gently over simmering water for 12 minutes until just set, with a tiny wobble.
Scatter the spring onion over the warm custards and serve.
notes: Food safety: the custard should be set through, at 75°C. Vegetarian only if dashi is plant-based.

recipes.title: Crisp Kimchi and Spring Onion Wedges
recipes.summary: Crisp pan-fried pancakes with sharp kimchi and spring onion.
steps: Mix the kimchi, flour, water, egg, spring onion and gochugaru into a thick batter.
Fry in the oil over medium heat for 4 minutes each side until golden and crisp.
Cut into wedges and serve with the soy sauce and vinegar dip.
notes: Vegetarian. Kimchi may contain fish sauce.

recipes.title: Dalgona Honeycomb Candy
recipes.summary: Crunchy golden honeycomb candy made with sugar and bicarbonate of soda.
steps: Line a tray with baking paper.
Heat the sugar and water in a pot without stirring for 8 minutes until deep amber.
Take off the heat and whisk in the bicarbonate of soda; it will puff up hugely.
Pour out and cool for 20 minutes until hard, then break into pieces.
notes: Dessert. Vegan and gluten-free. Hot sugar burns severely; keep children away.

recipes.title: Japchae with Mushrooms
recipes.summary: Glossy glass noodles with vegetables and mushrooms in sweet soy sauce.
steps: Boil the noodles for 6 minutes until chewy and transparent, drain and cut short.
Stir-fry the carrot and mushrooms in half the oil for 5 minutes until tender, wilt the spinach and remove.
Toss the noodles with the soy sauce, sugar, garlic and remaining oil, then fold in the vegetables.
Scatter with sesame seed and serve warm or at room temperature.
notes: Vegan. Gluten-free if tamari replaces soy sauce.

recipes.title: Tuna Kimbap Rolls
recipes.summary: Rice and filling rolled in nori, sliced into bite-size rounds.
steps: Cook the rice until tender and season with sesame oil, seeds and salt.
Mix the tuna with the mayonnaise.
Spread rice over each nori sheet, leaving a border, and add tuna, carrot and cucumber in a line.
Roll tightly, brush with sesame oil and slice into rounds.
notes: Food safety: keep refrigerated and eat within a day.

recipes.title: Doenjang Veggie Stew
recipes.summary: Savoury fermented soy paste stew with tofu, zucchini and mushrooms.
steps: Whisk the miso into the stock in a pot and bring to a gentle simmer until dissolved.
Add the potato and onion and cook for 8 minutes until almost tender.
Add the zucchini, mushrooms and tofu and simmer for 6 minutes until tender.
Add the chilli and serve with rice.
notes: Vegan.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Congee with Ginger
recipes.summary: Sweet pumpkin rice porridge, a warm Thai-style breakfast.
steps: Simmer the rice, water and ginger for 25 minutes, stirring until thick.
Add the pumpkin and cook for 10 minutes until soft and breaking down.
Season with soy sauce and top with spring onion and shallots.
notes: Vegan.

recipes.title: Green Curry Chicken Lunch Bowls
recipes.summary: Creamy green curry with chicken, bamboo-style beans and rice.
steps: Cook the rice by your usual method until fluffy.
Fry the paste in a pot for 2 minutes until fragrant, then add the chicken for 4 minutes until sealed.
Add the milk, stock, beans, fish sauce and sugar and simmer for 12 minutes until the chicken is cooked through.
Stir through the basil and serve over rice.
notes: Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C.

recipes.title: Charred Wide Noodles with Tofu and Gai Lan
recipes.summary: Wide rice noodles charred with soy, greens and tofu.
steps: Fry the tofu in half the oil for 5 minutes until golden, then remove.
Stir-fry the garlic and gai lan for 2 minutes, push aside and scramble the eggs until just set.
Add the noodles, sauces and sugar and toss for 4 minutes until the noodles char slightly.
Return the tofu and toss.
notes: Food safety: cook the eggs until set. Vegetarian only if oyster sauce is replaced; contains oyster.

recipes.title: Pineapple Coconut Sorbet Cups
recipes.summary: Frozen pineapple and coconut sorbet, scooped into fruit cups.
steps: Freeze the pineapple until solid.
Blend with the coconut cream, lime juice and icing sugar until smooth.
Freeze for 2 hours until scoopable, then serve topped with coconut.
notes: Dessert. Plus 4 hours freezing. Vegan and gluten-free.

recipes.title: Thai Peanut Satay Tofu Skewers
recipes.summary: Grilled marinated tofu skewers with peanut satay sauce.
steps: Toss the tofu with the soy sauce, turmeric and 1 tbsp satay sauce and rest for 20 minutes.
Thread onto skewers and grill for 10 minutes, turning until golden and charred.
Warm the peanut butter, satay sauce, lime juice and milk until smooth and bubbling.
Serve the skewers with cucumber and sauce.
notes: Vegan. Check satay sauce for gluten if needed.

recipes.title: Larb-Style Mushroom Lettuce Cups
recipes.summary: Zesty minced mushroom with toasted rice powder, chilli and herbs in lettuce cups.
steps: Toast the rice in a dry pan for 3 minutes until golden, then grind to a powder.
Fry the mushrooms in the oil for 8 minutes until browned and dry.
Toss with the lime juice, fish sauce, rice powder, shallot, chilli and herbs.
Spoon into lettuce leaves.
notes: Gluten-free. Use soy sauce for vegan.

recipes.title: Egg Pancake Wrap with Rice Noodles
recipes.summary: Thin egg crepes filled with vermicelli, herbs and prawns.
steps: Soak the vermicelli in boiling water for 4 minutes until tender, then drain.
Whisk the eggs and cook thin crepes in the oil for 1 minute each side until set.
Cook the prawns for 3 minutes until pink and opaque.
Mix the fish sauce, lime juice and sugar and toss through the noodles, carrot and mint.
Fill the crepes with the filling and prawns and roll.
notes: Food safety: prawns must be opaque and pink; eggs set through.

recipes.title: Chè Three-Colour Dessert Glass
recipes.summary: Layered mung-free sweet dessert of red lentil, coconut and jelly-free toppings.
steps: Simmer the lentils in water for 12 minutes until soft, then mash with half the sugar.
Boil the sweet potato for 8 minutes until tender.
Simmer the coconut milk with the remaining sugar and salt for 5 minutes until slightly thick.
Layer the lentil, sweet potato and ice in glasses and pour over the coconut milk.
notes: Dessert. Vegan and gluten-free.

recipes.title: Vietnamese Caramel Pork Rice Pots
recipes.summary: Sticky caramelised pork belly with eggs, served with steamed rice.
steps: Caramelise the sugar in a pot over medium heat for 5 minutes until deep amber.
Add the pork and brown for 5 minutes, then the fish sauce, garlic and water.
Cover and simmer for 45 minutes, until the pork is very tender.
Boil the eggs for 8 minutes, peel and add to the pot for 5 minutes.
Cook the rice until fluffy and serve topped with the pork, eggs and spring onion.
notes: Food safety: pork must reach 70°C and be very tender.

recipes.title: Fresh Lemongrass Chicken Banh Mi Salad
recipes.summary: Lemongrass chicken over rice noodles with fresh herbs.
steps: Marinate the chicken in the lemongrass, 1 tbsp fish sauce and half the sugar for 20 minutes.
Fry the chicken for 8 minutes until golden and cooked through.
Soak the vermicelli in boiling water for 4 minutes until tender and drain.
Whisk the remaining fish sauce, sugar and lime juice.
Toss everything together with the herbs.
notes: Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C. Plus 20 minutes marinating.

recipes.title: Pho-Style Mushroom Broth
recipes.summary: Fragrant star anise and cinnamon vegetable broth with rice noodles and herbs.
steps: Char the onion and ginger in a dry pan for 5 minutes until blackened in spots.
Simmer the stock with the charred onion, ginger, star anise and cinnamon for 25 minutes.
Strain, add the mushrooms and soy sauce and simmer for 5 minutes.
Cook the noodles until tender, divide into bowls and ladle over the broth.
Top with sprouts, basil and lime.
notes: Vegan.

recipes.title: Pandan-Free Coconut Rice Cake
recipes.summary: Steamed coconut rice flour cake, soft and chewy.
steps: Whisk the flours, milk, water and sugar until smooth.
Pour into a greased tin and steam over simmering water for 30 minutes until set.
Cool completely, slice and scatter with coconut.
notes: Dessert. Vegan and gluten-free.

recipes.title: Nasi Goreng Egg Muffins
recipes.summary: Little baked egg muffins flavoured like Indonesian fried rice.
steps: Heat the oven to 180°C and grease a 6-hole tin.
Mix the rice with the kecap manis, sambal, spring onion and pea.
Press into the holes and top each with a whisked egg.
Bake for 18 minutes until the eggs are set and golden.
notes: Food safety: eggs must be set through. Vegetarian.

recipes.title: Soto Ayam Turmeric Broth with Glass Noodles
recipes.summary: Turmeric chicken broth with noodles, egg and lime.
steps: Simmer the chicken with the water, lemongrass, galangal, turmeric and lime leaf for 30 minutes.
Remove the chicken and shred it, discarding bones.
Boil the eggs for 8 minutes, peel and halve.
Soak the noodles in hot water until tender.
Assemble bowls with noodles, chicken, egg and sprouts and ladle over the hot broth.
notes: Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C.

recipes.title: Perkedel Corn and Potato Patties
recipes.summary: Crisp spiced potato and corn patties served with sambal.
steps: Boil the potato for 12 minutes until tender, drain and mash.
Mix in the corn, egg, spring onion, garlic and coriander and shape into 8 patties.
Fry in oil over medium heat for 4 minutes each side until golden.
Serve the patties hot with a spoonful of sambal on the side.
notes: Vegetarian.

recipes.title: Serabi Coconut Pancakes
recipes.summary: Tiny soft coconut-milk pancakes with a crisp base.
steps: Whisk the flour, milk, water, sugar, baking powder and salt into a smooth batter and rest.
Heat a small pan and pour in a ladleful, cover and cook for 4 minutes until holes appear and the base is golden.
Repeat, then serve with palm sugar syrup (simmered with a spoonful of water until syrupy).
notes: Plus 20 minutes resting. Vegan and gluten-free.

recipes.title: Malaysian Chicken Rice Bowls
recipes.summary: Poached chicken with fragrant rice, ginger sauce and cucumber.
steps: Poach the chicken in simmering stock with the ginger for 25 minutes until cooked through.
Fry the garlic in the sesame oil until golden and cook the rice in 2 cups of the stock until fluffy.
Mix the grated ginger, soy sauce and a spoon of stock into a dipping sauce.
Slice the chicken and serve with rice, cucumber and sauce.
notes: Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C and juices run clear.

recipes.title: Kaya Toast with Soft Eggs
recipes.summary: Toasted bread with sweet coconut jam and runny eggs.
steps: Mix the jam with the coconut to make a quick kaya-style spread.
Toast the bread until golden and spread with butter and the jam.
Bring a pot of water to the boil, add the eggs and cook for 6 minutes until the whites are set and yolks soft.
Crack the eggs into a bowl, season with soy sauce and serve with the warm toast until the plate is full.
notes: Food safety: soft eggs are not suitable for anyone vulnerable; cook until firm if serving them. Vegetarian.

recipes.title: Sambal Eggplant Rice Plates
recipes.summary: Soft eggplant coated in tangy sambal with rice.
steps: Cook the rice by your usual method until fluffy.
Fry the eggplant in the oil for 10 minutes until golden and soft.
Add the garlic, sambal, tamarind and sugar and cook for 3 minutes until sticky.
Stir through the basil and serve over rice.
notes: Vegan and gluten-free.

recipes.title: Filipino Garlic Rice and Egg Breakfast Plates
recipes.summary: Crunchy garlic fried rice with fried eggs and tomato.
steps: Fry the garlic in the oil for 2 minutes until golden and crisp.
Add the rice and soy sauce and stir for 4 minutes until heated through and toasty.
Fry the eggs separately for 3 minutes until the whites are set.
Serve with tomato and spring onion.
notes: Food safety: cool leftover rice and refrigerate within 1 hour; cook eggs until the whites are firm. Vegetarian.

recipes.title: Pork Adobo Lunch Bowls
recipes.summary: Soy and vinegar braised pork with garlic and bay, served over rice.
steps: Combine the pork, soy sauce, vinegar, garlic, bay leaf, pepper and water in a pot.
Simmer covered for 40 minutes until the pork is tender.
Uncover and cook for 8 minutes until the sauce reduces and the pork browns.
Cook the rice until fluffy and serve with the pork and sauce.
notes: Food safety: pork must reach 70°C and be very tender.

recipes.title: Ube-Free Purple Sweet Potato Halo-Halo Cups
recipes.summary: Layered shaved ice dessert with sweet potato, coconut and evaporated milk.
steps: Boil the sweet potato for 12 minutes until very soft, drain and mash with sugar.
Layer sweet potato, raisin and ice in tall glasses.
Pour over the milks and top with coconut.
notes: Dessert. Vegetarian and gluten-free.

recipes.title: Chana Masala Pita Pockets
recipes.summary: Spiced chickpea curry stuffed into warm pita with yoghurt.
steps: Fry the onion in the oil for 6 minutes until golden, add the paste and spices for 1 minute.
Add the tomato and cook for 5 minutes until jammy, then the chickpeas and 1/2 cup water.
Simmer for 8 minutes until thick.
Warm the pita, fill with chickpeas and top with yoghurt and coriander.
notes: Vegetarian.

recipes.title: Vegan Coconut Dal Soup
recipes.summary: Creamy red lentil and coconut milk soup with turmeric.
steps: Fry the cumin and onion in the oil for 5 minutes until soft, add the garlic, ginger and turmeric for 1 minute.
Add the lentils and stock and simmer for 15 minutes until soft.
Stir in the milk and blend if you like, then finish with lime juice.
notes: Vegan and gluten-free.

recipes.title: Spiced Pumpkin Samosa Pastries
recipes.summary: Baked pastry parcels with spiced pumpkin and peas.
steps: Roast the pumpkin at 200°C for 15 minutes until tender.
Fry the onion, cumin and garam masala in the oil for 5 minutes, add pumpkin and peas and mash lightly.
Cut the pastry into triangles, fill and seal.
Brush with egg and bake at 200°C for 20 minutes until golden.
notes: Vegetarian.

recipes.title: Egg Bhurji Breakfast Wraps
recipes.summary: Spiced Indian scrambled egg in warm rotis.
steps: Fry the onion and chilli in the ghee for 4 minutes until soft.
Add the tomato and spices for 2 minutes, then pour in the beaten eggs.
Stir for 3 minutes until fully set, then fold in the coriander.
Spoon into warm rotis and roll up.
notes: Food safety: cook the eggs until firm and fully set. Vegetarian.

recipes.title: Gajar Halwa Carrot Pudding
recipes.summary: Slow-cooked carrot pudding with milk, ghee and cardamom.
steps: Cook the carrot in the ghee for 5 minutes until soft.
Add the milk and simmer for 25 minutes, stirring until the milk is absorbed.
Stir in the sugar, cardamom and raisins and cook for 5 minutes until thick, then top with pistachio.
notes: Dessert. Vegetarian and gluten-free.

recipes.title: Lamb Rogan Josh Pots
recipes.summary: Mild, rich lamb curry with Kashmiri chilli and yoghurt.
steps: Brown the lamb in the ghee in batches until golden, then remove.
Fry the onions for 8 minutes until deep golden, add the paste and spices for 1 minute.
Return the lamb, add the yoghurt, tomatoes and water.
Simmer covered for 75 minutes until the lamb is very tender.
notes: Food safety: braise lamb until very tender, well above 70°C.

recipes.title: Aloo Gobi Sheet-Pan Bake
recipes.summary: Spiced potato and cauliflower roasted with turmeric and cumin.
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan) and line a large tray.
Toss everything except the coriander and lime with the oil and salt on a tray.
Roast for 35 minutes, turning once, until golden and tender.
Finish with coriander and lime.
notes: Vegan and gluten-free.

recipes.title: Mango Lassi Overnight Oats
recipes.summary: Chilled oats soaked in yoghurt and mango, a cooling breakfast.
steps: Mix the oats, yoghurt, milk, cardamom and honey in a jar.
Chill overnight until thick.
Top each jar with diced mango and serve cold.
notes: Plus overnight soaking. Vegetarian.

recipes.title: Ethiopian-Style Spiced Chicken and Egg
recipes.summary: Mild chicken and boiled eggs in an onion and paprika sauce.
steps: Cook the onions in a dry pot for 10 minutes until soft and golden, add the ghee, paste and spices for 3 minutes.
Add the chicken and water and simmer for 30 minutes until cooked through.
Boil the eggs for 8 minutes, peel and add to the pot.
Simmer for 5 minutes to warm through.
notes: Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C.

recipes.title: Tanzanian Coconut Rice with Peas
recipes.summary: Fragrant coconut rice cooked with cardamom and peas.
steps: Rinse the rice under cold water until it runs clear.
Bring the milk, water, spices and salt to the boil, add the rice and cover until simmering gently.
Cook on low for 15 minutes until the liquid is absorbed, then add the peas.
Rest off the heat for 5 minutes until fluffy and serve.
notes: Vegan and gluten-free.

recipes.title: Ugandan Rolex Egg Wraps
recipes.summary: Egg omelette rolled inside a warm flatbread with tomato and cabbage.
steps: Whisk the eggs with the tomato, cabbage and onion.
Cook in the oil over medium heat for 3 minutes until set, then lay a roti on top and flip.
Roll up tightly and slice.
notes: Food safety: eggs must be fully set. Vegetarian.

recipes.title: Malva Pudding with Apricot Sauce
recipes.summary: Warm sponge pudding soaked in a creamy apricot sauce.
steps: Whisk the eggs and half the sugar, beat in the jam, butter, flour and bicarbonate of soda.
Pour into a dish and bake at 180°C for 30 minutes until risen and golden.
Heat the cream, milk, remaining sugar and water until warm.
Pour over the hot pudding and let it soak.
notes: Dessert. Vegetarian.

recipes.title: Mealie Cornbread with Chilli Butter
recipes.summary: Moist cornbread with sweet corn, brushed with chilli butter.
steps: Mix the polenta, flour, baking powder, corn, milk and eggs.
Pour into a lined tin and bake at 200°C for 30 minutes until golden and set.
Melt the butter with the chilli for 1 minute and brush over.
notes: Vegetarian.

recipes.title: Sosatie Skewers with Apricot Glaze
recipes.summary: Marinated lamb and apricot skewers grilled until sticky.
steps: Mix the jam, curry powder, vinegar and oil and coat the lamb.
Thread the lamb, onion and apricot onto skewers.
Grill for 12 minutes, turning until browned and cooked through.
notes: Food safety: lamb pieces must reach 70°C. Plus 2 hours marinating.

recipes.title: Fijian Kokoda Fish Salad
recipes.summary: Lime-cured fish with coconut cream and fresh vegetables.
steps: Cure the fish in lime juice for 30 minutes until opaque.
Drain, then fold in the coconut cream and vegetables.
Chill for 15 minutes until cold and serve in small bowls.
notes: Food safety: fish should turn opaque with the acid; use very fresh fish. Plus 30 minutes curing. Gluten-free.

recipes.title: Tongan Lu Sipi Style Lamb Parcels
recipes.summary: Lamb and coconut cream steamed in foil with onions.
steps: Mix the lamb with the onion, ginger and salt, then divide onto foil sheets.
Spoon over the coconut cream and seal tightly.
Bake at 170°C for 90 minutes until the lamb is very tender.
notes: Food safety: lamb must reach 70°C and be very tender. Gluten-free.
